interpretation.mandatory_start: Measured velocity projected on actual vehicle forward axis >=4m/s; this cannot be lowered by config.
interpretation.opening_motion: Entire first2s >=0.5m/s forward, excluding settled-body numerical jitter.
interpretation.derivatives: Raw gradients always reported; quality gates use a fixed0.5s quadratic least-squares fit, min5 actual samples, including one-sided endpoints. No spike deletion.
interpretation.smoothness: Acceleration+4/braking-6m/s2, p95absjerk6/maxabsjerk12m/s3 are declared project targets, not legal or industry standards.
interpretation.controls: Per-second actual throttle/brake/steer differences; thresholds are rates and do not silently depend on FPS.
interpretation.clearance: All recorded pairs>=0.75m and ego pairs>=1m full3D native OBB. Any negative clearance below1micrometer counts as bbox overlap; this does not assert mesh contact.
interpretation.traffic: Chase opening mean>=2 projected neighbors within80m and >=96px2, candidate present/active in75% samples. Pure calibrated geometry; occlusion remains unknown.
interpretation.pixels: Optional native instance rendered masks bound to callback rawSHA; missing rawBGRA is allowed only if entire PNG-derived BGRA exactSHA matches. No assumed actor mapping.
